lead_raw_text:
The structure of AlFeO₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group P2₁/c (No. 38), with a 16-atom unit cell (Al₄Fe₄O₈) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives octahedral coordination for all centers: Al and Fe are each surrounded by six O neighbors, while O centers have two Al and four Fe neighbors, with Al–O distances of 1.77–2.17 Å and Fe–O distances of 1.86–1.95 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between O octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Al and Fe octahedra.
